items.question: What is Blastrr?
items.answer: Blastrr provides simulated Forex and crypto trading accounts. You select a plan, connect a supported Web3 wallet, and trade with simulated account balances using market data for instruments shown in the terminal. Simulated results are not live exchange trades and do not guarantee a reward or payment.

items.question: How do I log in?
items.answer: Open the Blastrr app and connect a compatible Web3 wallet. The app asks you to sign a message to verify wallet access. Email and password sign-in are not currently offered.

items.question: Do I need a wallet to use the app?
items.answer: Yes. Wallet connection and message signing are used to access your dashboard and account features. Keep your wallet secure and only approve actions you understand.

items.question: Where can I get help?
items.answer: Submit an account support ticket from Profile & Promos in the app. For purchase or account-access issues, include the wallet address and relevant transaction details. Do not share your seed phrase or private keys.

items.question: What account plans are available?
items.answer: The app currently lists straight-to-funded simulated plans from $5,000 to $250,000 in simulated capital. Plan availability, purchase price, discount, target, and risk settings are shown on the Buy Plans page and may change.

items.question: Is there an evaluation or challenge phase?
items.answer: The current plans are straight-to-funded; they do not require completing a separate evaluation phase before account access. Plan rules and account activation still apply.

items.question: How do I pay for a plan?
items.answer: Plan purchases use USDT through the supported network selected in the app. The homepage and checkout show the currently supported networks. Match the selected network and token in your wallet before confirming; sending on a different network can result in loss of funds.

items.question: Are plan balances real money?
items.answer: No. Plan capital and trading balances are simulated. A plan purchase is a real payment for platform access, but it does not deposit real trading capital or create a live brokerage account.

items.question: What should I do if payment is confirmed but my account is missing?
items.answer: Refresh the app and check My Accounts. If the account is still missing, submit a support ticket with the purchase network and transaction hash. Never send another payment just because provisioning is delayed.

items.question: How are prices and discounts determined?
items.answer: Current plan prices and the standard discount are displayed on the homepage and in Buy Plans. Eligible promo codes may apply additional offers as described at checkout. The final amount shown before payment is the amount to verify in your wallet.

items.question: Which markets can I trade?
items.answer: The terminal has separate Forex and Crypto market modes. Forex currently lists EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, NZD/USD, and XAU/USD. Crypto currently lists 20 Binance Spot pairs quoted in USDT. Check the terminal's market selectors for current availability.

items.question: Are prices live?
items.answer: The terminal streams live Forex quotes from Swissquote and configured crypto prices from Binance Spot. Forex chart history uses a separate data feed from its live quote. Feeds can be delayed or unavailable; prices are references for simulated trading and do not promise an identical live-market fill.

items.question: When can I trade?
items.answer: Forex currency pairs generally quote around the clock on weekdays, with weekend and holiday closures; XAU/USD may follow its own instrument sessions. Crypto Spot markets generally trade 24/7. Provider or platform maintenance can affect availability, and Forex quotes may be stale while markets are closed.

items.question: How do I place a trade?
items.answer: Select an account, choose Forex or Crypto mode and an instrument, then select Market or Limit entry. Forex position size is entered in lots at 1x; Crypto size is entered as USD collateral margin. Choose an available leverage multiplier, set optional Stop Loss and Take Profit values, review the estimates, then submit Buy / Long or Sell / Short. Orders and balances are simulated.

items.question: Does the app support limit, stop-limit, or pending entry orders?
items.answer: Yes. Choose Limit Orders in the terminal and set a trigger price. A Buy limit can trigger when the market reaches or falls below the limit; a Sell limit can trigger when it reaches or rises above the limit. Until triggered, the order appears under Pending Limit Orders; filled orders move to open positions. Orders are simulated.

items.question: Can I set a Stop Loss or Take Profit?
items.answer: Yes. Forex Stop Loss and Take Profit inputs use pip distances by default; Crypto inputs use trigger prices. You can switch either market mode to dollar P&L amounts with the order-ticket control. These protections are part of simulated positions.

items.question: What do the market information fields show?
items.answer: The selected-market bar shows the live price, bid/ask, 24-hour change, high, and low where available. Crypto Spot instruments also show quote volume in USDT. Forex instruments do not have the same USDT volume field.

items.question: What risk limits apply to plans?
items.answer: Current plan settings are shown on the plan card. The configured plans use a 5% daily loss limit, 10% maximum loss parameter, a profit target equal to 20% of simulated starting capital, and a 40% maximum single-day share of profit for reward eligibility. Check the current plan and terms before trading.

items.question: How does the daily loss limit work?
items.answer: The daily loss limit is calculated from the account's daily starting balance and resets using the platform's UTC day boundary. A daily-limit breach locks the account until the earlier of the 24-hour lock expiry or the next UTC midnight.

items.question: Is maximum drawdown static or trailing?
items.answer: The current risk implementation uses the plan's maximum-loss percentage against a high-water mark, capped at 110% of initial balance. The loss floor can therefore rise as the high-water mark increases, until it reaches the initial balance; it does not rise above the initial balance.

items.question: What happens if I breach a risk limit?
items.answer: A daily loss breach can temporarily lock the account. A maximum-loss breach can permanently lock it. The app may reject new trades while an account is locked; see the account status and current platform rules for the specific outcome.

items.question: What does leverage mean in the order ticket?
items.answer: The terminal offers 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 20x, and 50x multipliers on eligible instruments. In Forex mode, the lot-size field is the base position size at 1x; the multiplier increases simulated exposure. In Crypto mode, the multiplier applies to the USD collateral margin. Higher leverage magnifies the effect of price moves on simulated PnL, including losses. Check the instrument and account controls in the app.

items.question: Are trades real exchange orders?
items.answer: No. Forex and crypto trades, positions, balances, and PnL in Blastrr are simulated. Market data is used as a reference, but Blastrr does not submit these simulated orders to an exchange order book.

items.question: Where do I see my accounts?
items.answer: Connect your wallet and open My Accounts to review the accounts linked to it. Select an active account from the order-entry area before placing a trade.

items.question: Can I claim a free account with a code?
items.answer: If you have a one-time promotional account code, enter it in the Claim a free account section under Profile & Promos. Each code can be used once, and the account plan is determined by the code.

items.question: Can I apply to become a creator?
items.answer: Yes. Open Profile & Promos and submit the creator application with your social profile links and community details. You can edit and resubmit it. The Blastrr team reviews applications; approval and any custom referral commission are not automatic.

items.question: How do referral codes work?
items.answer: Your profile displays your referral code and shareable link. Referral tracking and any applicable commission are governed by the current program settings shown in your profile and platform terms.

items.question: What is BlastrrPass?
items.answer: BlastrrPass is the app's XP, points, and rank program. Its profile and mission views show your current progress and available rewards.

items.question: How do I earn XP and points?
items.answer: Eligible account purchases and missions shown in BlastrrPass can award XP and points. Mission requirements, awards, and availability are managed by the platform and displayed in the app.

items.question: What do ranks and points unlock?
items.answer: BlastrrPass progress determines your displayed rank. Rewards and redemption requirements are shown in the app; availability and terms may change.

items.question: Can I share my BlastrrPass profile?
items.answer: Set up your profile username in the app, then use its share control to open a prefilled post on X. Profile-image and sharing options are subject to the controls shown in BlastrrPass.

items.question: Does reaching the profit target guarantee a payout?
items.answer: No. A simulated profit target is an account metric, not a promise of payment or financial return. Any reward or withdrawal request is subject to account rules, eligibility, review, and current platform terms.

items.question: How do I request a withdrawal or reward?
items.answer: Use the relevant request control in your account or profile. Available request types, balances, protected amounts, and status are shown by the app. A request may be reviewed by an administrator before it is processed.

items.question: Where can I check a request's status?
items.answer: Review the account or profile history and any status displayed in the app. If you need help, submit a support ticket with the request details.

items.question: Are rewards or withdrawals guaranteed?
items.answer: No. Simulated performance does not guarantee a reward, payout, or financial return. Requests are subject to current eligibility, platform rules, review, and applicable terms.

items.question: What should I do if the market ticker or prices stop updating?
items.answer: Check your internet connection and refresh the app. Forex prices may not update while the relevant market is closed; a provider or Blastrr may also be temporarily unavailable. Do not rely on a stale quote; wait for live data to resume before submitting a simulated trade.

items.question: What if I cannot connect my wallet?
items.answer: Confirm that your wallet extension or app is available, unlock it, and reload Blastrr. Use the wallet connection controls provided by the app. Never share your recovery phrase or private keys with support.

items.question: Can I send tokens to my simulated trading account?
items.answer: No. Simulated trading balances are not wallet deposit addresses. Only send USDT for a plan purchase when the app explicitly provides a supported payment flow, and verify the network and transaction details first.
